description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans activation lifecycle and garbage collection, specifically testing activation collector behavior, idle/busy activation collection, and configuration-based collection limits.

classes.name: ActivationCollectorTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for Orleans activation collector and garbage collection behaviors, including idle and busy activation collection and configuration-based limits.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the test cluster with specified collection age limit and quantum.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Disposes the test cluster asynchronously, stopping silos and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: ActivationCollectorForceCollection
methods.description: Tests that the activation collector correctly forces collection of idle activations.

methods.name: ActivationCollectorShouldCollectIdleActivations
methods.description: Verifies that idle activations are collected after the specified timeout.

methods.name: ActivationCollectorShouldNotCollectBusyActivations
methods.description: Checks that busy activations are not prematurely collected.

methods.name: ManualCollectionShouldNotCollectBusyActivations
methods.description: Ensures manual collection does not collect busy activations.

methods.name: ActivationCollectorShouldCollectIdleActivationsSpecifiedInPerTypeConfiguration
methods.description: Checks collection based on per-type specific age limit configuration.

methods.name: ActivationCollectorShouldNotCollectBusyActivationsSpecifiedInPerTypeConfiguration
methods.description: Ensures that per-type configuration prevents collection of busy activations.

methods.name: ActivationCollectorShouldNotCollectBusyStatelessWorkers
methods.description: Test (skipped) verifying that idle stateless worker activations are identified and handled correctly.

methods.name: ActivationCollectorShouldCollectByCollectionSpecificAgeLimit
methods.description: Verifies collection when a specific age limit per type is set, e.g., 12 seconds.

methods.name: NonReentrantGrainTimer_NoKeepAlive_Test
methods.description: Tests scheduling a timer on a grain that should deactivate the grain after the timer expires and no keep-alive.

classes.name: SiloConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo with specific collection options for testing.
